title: PartPilot CPU specification research batch 001
methodology: Prefer exact AMD SKU pages. Where AMD's official launch documentation provides only a total cache figure, the L2/L3 split is based on the documented architecture configuration and the record notes this limitation. Missing values are not inferred.

records.specificationNotes: Exact desktop SKU specifications from AMD: 16C/32T, 3.4–4.9 GHz, 8 MB L2, 64 MB L3, 105 W, AM4, DDR4-3200, PCIe 4.0; discrete graphics required.
